availability.note: Live Build & Price line 'MGS5 EV Essence 49kWh RWD' with VIC selectable in the state list; only two grades in the configurator, matching CarExpert's MY26 pricing story (Excite grades dropped)

listPrice.note: No list price published anywhere. MG configurator variant price $41,990 is MG's national Drive Away Price (struck through; $39,990* shown as 'Drive Away Price, Offer ends 31 December' with a $2,000 cashback on sales/deliveries 01 Nov-31 Dec 2026, a campaign, not used). The configurator template's '+ On-Road Costs' subtitle is generic: the per-state 'discount' it applies cancels the on-road fees so every state lands on the same figure. CarExpert (8 Jul 2026) called the previous regular price $42,990 drive-away, so the held listPrice was a drive-away figure. Back-out: (41990 - 880) / 1.042 = 39453; round-trip driveAwayPrice(39453) = 41,990.03. Independent check: the configurator's state discounts for the two grades differ by $201.60 in VIC (= 24 x $8.40 duty units) and $147 in NSW (3% of ~$4,900), i.e. dutiable values about $4,800 apart, matching the backed-out list gap of $4,798 rather than the $5,000 drive-away gap. Flat national drive-away may bundle dealer delivery, so this list may overstate by an unknown amount.

batteryKwh.note: MG AU says '49kWh LFP battery'. evdb.nz gives 51 kWh gross / 49 kWh usable for the NZ 49 Essence (same pack). Conflict: ev-database (EU 49 kWh car) gives 49.0 nominal / 47.1 usable. Kept 49 per evdb.nz, which also gives 65/62 for the 62 pack consistently.

rangeKm.note: MG AU MY26 brochure spec table 'Driving Range: WLTP Combined Cycle (km)' 335; same table gives NEDC 410 (rejected). EU WLTP 340 km (ev-database) is higher than AU 335, so 335 is the local WLTP-derived spec.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: MG AU brochure 'Driving Efficiency (Wh/km)' 169; includes charging losses, so it sits 16% above battery/range (14.6)

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Boot Volume Seats In Place 453 L; same on MG model page

seats.note: 5 seats; MG brochure lists 40/60 rear folding seat with three rear belts

towKg.note: Maximum Towing Weight Braked (kg) 750 in MG AU brochure spec table

warrantyYears.note: Standard 7 years/unlimited km; 10 years/250,000km only with every service at an MG dealer (conditional, in pros). HV battery 7 years/150,000km.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to byd-atto3 rows (Essential $39,990 -> 1500, Premium $44,990 -> 1600) at near-identical list prices, and below mg-s6 Essence RWD (1650 at $47,130)

depreciationCurve.note: Mainstream default; owner decision 2026-11-26 to use one mainstream curve for all MG rows.
